plain.name: Departures in Norway
plain.gives: Departures from any stop in Norway, every bus, tram, train, boat, and airport bus, with the live time when the operator reports it, and trips between two places.
plain.from: Entur, on behalf of Norway's public transport
plain.asks: Nothing until you build a tile from it. The message it sends names Bergen bus station; put your own stop's Entur identity in its place, found under Stops and places.

terms.note: Free and open; Entur asks for a client name header on every request.

source.body: {"query":"{ stopPlace(id: \"NSR:StopPlace:62356\") { name estimatedCalls(numberOfDepartures: 5) { expectedDepartureTime aimedDepartureTime realtime quay { publicCode } destinationDisplay { frontText } serviceJourney { line { publicCode transportMode } } } } }"}
